data.name: Eshraat
data.gender_notes: Eshraat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A gift or reward given to someone, often as a result of their hard work or efforts. The name Eshraat carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Eshraat usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The blessings and rewards that come from Allah, often as a result of good deeds and righteous actions.
data.etymology: Eshraat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Reward.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eshraat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: إشراط
in_arabic.meaning: إشراط يعني الإشارة أو الدلالة على شيء ما
in_arabic.long_meaning: إشراط هو اسم مشتق من الفعل أشرط، والذي يعني الإشارة أو الدلالة على شيء ما. هذا الاسم له دلالة على الهداية والنور، حيث يشير إلى الشخص الذي يدل على الطريق الصحيح أو يشرق بنور العلم والمعرفة. في اللغة العربية، الاسم إشراط يوحي بالفكر السليم والمنطق الحكيم.

in_urdu.name: اشراط
in_urdu.meaning: اشراط کا مطلب ہے اشارہ یا علامت
in_urdu.long_meaning: اشراط ایک نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے فعل 'أشرط' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اشارہ کرنا یا علامت بنانا۔ یہ نام ہدایت اور علم کی روشنی کی دلالت کرتا ہے، جیسے کہ جو شخص صحیح راستہ دکھاتا ہے یا علم و حکمت کی روشنی سے چمکتا ہے۔ اردو زبان میں، اشراط نام عقلمند اور حكيم شخصیت کی خصوصیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इशरात
in_hindi.meaning: इशरात का अर्थ है संकेत या चिह्न
in_hindi.long_meaning: इशरात एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के क्रियापद 'أشرط' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है संकेत करना या चिह्न बनाना। यह नाम मार्गदर्शन और ज्ञान के प्रकाश को दर्शाता है, जैसे कि जो व्यक्ति सही रास्ता दिखाता है या ज्ञान और बुद्धिमत्ता के प्रकाश से चमकता है। हिंदी में, इशरात नाम बुद्धिमान और समझदार व्यक्तित्व की विशेषता को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: اشراط
in_pashto.meaning: اشراط دليل یا نښه معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: اشراط د عربي ژبې د 'أشرط' فعل څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چې معنی یې دليل یا نښه کول دي. دا نوم د هدایت او پوهې د رڼا دلالت کوي، لکه څوک چې د سمو لارې ښودنه کوي یا د پوهې او حکمت د رڼا سره روښانه وي. په پښتو کې، اشراط نوم د عقلمند او دانا شخصیت خصوصیت څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Eshraat
in_english.meaning: Eshraat means indication or sign in English
in_english.long_meaning: Eshraat is derived from the Arabic root 'أشرط', which means to indicate or signify. This name connotes guidance and illumination, suggesting a person who points the way or shines with the light of knowledge and wisdom. The name Eshraat reflects a thoughtful and intelligent personality, valued in various Muslim cultures for its deep etymological roots in Arabic linguistic tradition.

It can signify the idea of a reward earned through hard work, dedication, and perseverance, whether in one's career, education, or personal pursuits. This concept can bring a feeling of pride and joy to the individual carrying this name, as well as inspire ambition and motivation in those who hear it.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Eshraat can represent the rewards of virtue and good deeds in the hereafter. It serves as a reminder of the promises and blessings of God Almighty, encouraging individuals to strive towards inner growth, purification, and selflessness. The name can also signify the gifts and blessings that God bestows upon us every moment, and inspire gratitude and awe. Overall, Eshraat reminds us of the importance of both material and spiritual success, and the interconnected nature of the two in our lives as Muslims.
